notes: v2 (P3.2): expectations are machine-checkable. expect.canonical holds the event list in the tests/canonical.py grammar (the vocabulary of hid_mapping.md §2); expect.hid holds the scenario's HID output as hid_grammar.py records. Prose remains only in frame desc/source and scenario note fields.

Canonical annotations on expectation entries: omit_pending {deviation, drivers} means those drivers may omit the event while that specs/README.md deviation row is open (the annotation must be dropped when the row is fixed); keys_pending {deviation, keys, drivers} means the named event keys may be absent from those drivers' records while the row is open.

Gesture class is the wire value of GestureInfo bits 12-15 (0 garbage, 1 flick, 2 circle); edge is GestureInfo bit 16. Consumer usages are decimal usage IDs: Next Track 0x00B5=181, Previous Track 0x00B6=182, Volume Inc 0x00E9=233, Volume Dec 0x00EA=234. Page Up 0x4E=78, Page Down 0x4F=79.

Python expectations assume the decoder receives the message payload (frame[4:]) — the harness feeds it that way, and the driver's _do_poll strips the 4-byte header at dispatch (P3.3). Positions in canonical form are raw 16-bit units; the Python decoders' ±4-unit rounding tolerance is documented in tests/canonical.py.
Arduino touch codes: 0-4 doubletap center/south/east/west/north order per skywriter.h SW_* constants (SW_DOUBLETAP_CENTER=0 ... SW_TOUCH_SOUTH=14).
Reserved bits are kept as vendor wrote them where source=vendor; decoders must ignore them.

2026-11-04 revision: the AirWheel counter wrap is a signed 8-bit difference (wraps 255->0, 32 counts per revolution) — see specs/hid_mapping.md §2. F14 was re-authored from counter 0x1E to 0xFE; its '1e' filename label is stale (filenames are stable by rule) but the data value is 0xFE.

Provenance vocabulary: vendor = verbatim vendor bytes (F16 only); vendor-derived = vendor field values cited from Interface.pdf tables, repacked into our 26-byte frame; vendor pattern = vendor trace pattern with clean values; synthetic = constructed to the cited table layout.

F01_position_only.desc: Valid position x=500, y=1000, z=200; DSPRunning|PositionValid.

F02_flick_west_east.source: vendor-derived (Interface.pdf Table A-3, frame seq 0x4A, gesture word 02 10 02 00 — vendor field values repacked into our 26-byte mask-0x001F frame)
F02_flick_west_east.desc: Flick West->East, gesture class 1 (flick). Bit 17 of GestureInfo is set (reserved) and must be ignored.

F03_flick_east_west.desc: Flick East->West, gesture class 1 (flick), clean word 03 10 00 00.

F04_edge_flick_east_west.desc: Flick East->West with edge-flick flag (bit 16) set.

F05_gesture_in_progress.source: vendor pattern (Interface.pdf Table A-3 'Gesture Recognizer started' rows use word 00 00 00 80)
F05_gesture_in_progress.desc: Recognition in progress (bit 31), code 0: no gesture event.

F06_garbage_gesture.source: vendor pattern (Interface.pdf Table A-3 'Garbage recognized' row uses word 01 00 00 00)

F07_touch_center.source: vendor-derived (Interface.pdf Table A-3 'Touch Center Electrode' frame, touch word 10 00 09 00 — repacked)

F08_touch_center_hold.source: vendor-derived (Interface.pdf Table A-3 'Touch Counter Reset' frame, touch word 10 00 00 00 — repacked)
F08_touch_center_hold.desc: Touch Center still held, counter reset to 0.

F09_tap_center.source: vendor-derived (Interface.pdf Table A-3 'Tap on Center electrode' frame, touch word 00 02 00 00 — repacked)

F11_airwheel_step00.desc: AirWheel counter 00, AirWheelValid set. Baseline frame.

F12_airwheel_step08.desc: AirWheel counter 08: +8 steps (+90 deg) from F11.

F13_airwheel_step10.desc: AirWheel counter 10 (hex): +8 steps (+90 deg) from F12.

F14_airwheel_step1e.desc: AirWheel counter 0xFE (254 dec): setup for wrap test. The '1e' filename label is stale from the superseded modulo-32 draft (value is 0xFE; filenames are stable by rule).

F15_airwheel_step02.desc: AirWheel counter 02 after 0xFE: +4 steps (+45 deg) across the 255->0 wrap.

F16_status_ack_a2.desc: System_Status (0x15) ack to Set_Runtime_Parameter 0xA2, MaxCmdSize 0x34, ErrorCode 0x0000.

F17_fw_version_valid.source: synthetic (Interface.pdf Table 4-5 layout; version string transcribed from Example 3-1, NUL-padded to 120 bytes)

F18_touch_center_with_position.desc: Combined frame: Touch Center (counter 9) + valid position + AirWheel counter 08. Exercises multi-field decode.

F19_position_jump.desc: Position jumps to x=32768, y=32768 (z=4096): exercises jump rejection / re-baseline after F01.

scenarios.name: position_track
scenarios.note: Decoder level: one position event. The USB-HID side must NOT move the cursor here: per hid_mapping.md §3 rule 4 the first valid position only sets the pointer baseline; a follow-up frame would emit the delta [AC-MAP-01].

scenarios.name: position_jump_rebaseline
scenarios.note: F19's delta (+32268, +31768 raw) exceeds JUMP_THRESHOLD (8192), so the pointer model must discard the movement and re-baseline — pointer-model assertion (fix item P3.12); decode-level both positions are ordinary events.

scenarios.name: flick_west_east
scenarios.note: GestureInfo bit 17 (reserved, set in F02) must stay ignored. Inserted into the structured manifest (P3.2) from the reviewed prose expectations.

scenarios.name: edge_flick_east_west
scenarios.note: The edge-flick flag (bit 16) must survive into the canonical event (§2) even though the §6 mapping treats it like any east-west flick.

scenarios.name: garbage_gesture
scenarios.note: The gesture event itself is part of the decoder contract (§2); the §6 mapping table then maps garbage to nothing (which is why expect.hid is empty) [AC-MAP-05].

scenarios.name: touch_press_and_release
scenarios.note: Left button presses at F07 only; the F08 repeat must NOT re-press. Release is inferred after TOUCH_RELEASE_MS (200 ms) without touch frames — checked in the post-scenario simulated gap; the timed assertion arms with the clock-aware mapping adapter (P3.13). [AC-MAP-02]

scenarios.name: tap_center
scenarios.note: Tap-to-click: press + release of TAP_CLICK_MS (50 ms); never leaves a button held [AC-MAP-03].

scenarios.name: doubletap_center
scenarios.note: Two 50 ms clicks separated by TAP_CLICK_MS [AC-MAP-03].

scenarios.name: airwheel_quarter_turn_cw
scenarios.note: F11 (counter 00) is the baseline frame and emits nothing; one sensor step = 11.25 deg = one wheel notch, so +8 steps = +90 deg = 8 notches up per event [AC-MAP-04].

scenarios.name: airwheel_wrap
scenarios.note: F14 (0xFE) is the first airwheel frame of the scenario and acts as the silent baseline; F15's 0x02 vs 0xFE signed-8-bit difference is +4 steps = +45 deg — the 255->0 wrap counts forward, not -252 steps [AC-MAP-04]. See fix_plan airwheel-baseline item for the related F18 question.

scenarios.name: touch_with_position_and_airwheel

canonical.note: carries the legacy initial-counter=0 reading from the v1 manifest (+8 steps); the baseline rule agreed for F14 (first airwheel frame silent) would instead make this event never fire — decision lands with fix_plan's airwheel-baseline item at P3.14

scenarios.note: All fields of one frame processed: button down + wheel up + decoded position [AC-MAP-06]. On the HID side F18 alone sets the pointer baseline (§3 rule 4: no previous valid position) — no mouse movement is correct; the original prose 'mouse delta' is superseded by this structured record.

scenarios.name: status_ack
scenarios.note: System_Status (0x15) reply: Set_Runtime_Parameter id 0xA2 acknowledged with error 0x0000. Control frames produce no HID output; neither driver currently surfaces them as records (D9, fix item P3.11b).

scenarios.name: fw_version_valid
scenarios.note: Fw_Version_Info (0x83), FwValid 0xAA (valid; validity rules per Interface.pdf §4.3 — D6 tracks the Python driver's acceptance values), version string NUL-terminated. Control frames produce no HID output.
